Concerned with: Language models, NLP, machine learning, and teaching. In hand: AykanLLM-1.3B, a language model of my own. Studying: A GPT from scratch, by way of the NeetCode ML course. Exploring: Turkish NLP: its models, datasets and papers. Seeking: A position, and collaborators on LLMs and NLP. Remark: Has worked at a summer camp. Twice.. Correspondence: aykanugur157@gmail.com.
